relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 positively promotes autophagosome production through the upregulation of ATG5 and ATG7, which enhances autophagic processes

relationships.subject: FTO
relationships.evidence_quote: FTO inhibits apoptosis by demethylating BNIP3 mRNA and reducing the expression of the pro-apoptotic gene BNIP3

relationships.subject: METTL3
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL3 inhibits the expression of the important ferroptosis regulatory proteins SLC7A11 and FSP1, thereby promoting ferroptosis in human aortic smooth muscle cells (HASMCs)

relationships.subject: METTL14
relationships.evidence_quote: METTL14 promotes the methylation modification of the m6A of the beclin-1 transcript and enhances beclin-1 expression

key_findings: Review: m6A writers, erasers and readers regulate multiple regulated cell death forms (apoptosis, autophagy, ferroptosis) in musculoskeletal diseases.
Writers are the most studied m6A regulators in apoptosis, autophagy and ferroptosis; erasers and readers are less studied.
